definitions.name: Prometheus Pushgateway Delete Job Metrics
definitions.description: Delete exactly the metrics group whose only grouping label is job. Does not clear instance-specific groups or wipe the gateway.
definitions.documentation:
Delete exactly the metrics group whose only grouping label is job. Does not clear instance-specific groups or wipe the gateway.

DELETE /metrics/job/{job}. External write action; set confirmWrites=true and $retries=0 deliberately.

Inputs: job (optional). Missing inputs may come from the selected connection profile config or explicit node defaults. Outputs: status, request_id, operation_url. Optional outputs are absent when the provider omits them. HTTP202 is acceptance, not completed work; operation_url exposes a same-origin asynchronous status URL when supplied.

Setup: configure baseUrl (https://pushgateway.example.com), bearer credentials through encrypted secret names or Connections. Default secret name: PUSHGATEWAY_TOKEN. Connection credentials accessToken/apiKey or username/password are resolved at execution. Never put credentials in literal inputs, baseUrl or logs. Required access: Write permission for the selected resource.

Bounds: requestTimeoutMs=15000 (100..120000), maxBytes=1048576 (1024..3000000), maxItems=1000 (1..5000), maxPages=1 (1..20). One bounded request; use the provider-specific explicit paging inputs where offered. HTTPS is required; private HTTP needs allowHttp=true. TLS validation remains enabled. Redirects, cross-origin/escaped continuation URLs and repeated continuations fail. No implicit retries. Error text contains provider/status only, never raw response bodies or credentials. Reconcile an uncertain external action before another attempt.

Synthetic example inputs:

```json
{
  "job": "demo"
}
```

This example is documentation, not a run. 

Source: https://github.com/prometheus/pushgateway/blob/master/README.md
